lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: do you have a minute?
Yes, what is it?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I wanted to ask you a question:

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: What is my

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: most charming aspect?
Your long, sleek, black hair.
Your impeccably clean and crisp blue uniform.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Oh my goodness!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Thank you for saying that, hehe.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Even though that's the answer I wanted to hear,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: it's still a bit embarrassing to hear it in person, hehe.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: But my uniform doesn't have anything to do with me personally.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: They're just a set of clothes that anyone could wear.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Personally, I think my hair is my most alluring aspect, hehe.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: A while back,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: some customers told me I should cut my hair.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: They said it was too long and thought that it looked messy.
What hairstyle you have is none of their business.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: That's what I thought,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: but it is a bit on the long side, which makes it hard to manage sometimes.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I was thinking of

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: switching things up and snipping it a bit.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Okay, next question.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: What kind of hairstyle do you think is best?
Long and straight black hair.
Whatever is the best fit.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Are you only saying that because I'm here?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I guess you're right.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: It's all about what look suits you.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: So, if I'm reading you correctly,

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: are you saying that my current hairstyle is what suits me best?
Yes. It's perfect for you.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Hehe, really?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Thanks for restoring my confidence, Commander.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I'll stick with my long hair

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: just as it is.
